# HL7 Sample Fixtures

This directory contains sample HL7 messages that can be used for testing purposes.

## Contents

- [ADT_A01_1.hl7](ADT_A01_1.hl7): Sample ADT A01 message
- [ADT_A01_2.hl7](ADT_A01_2.hl7): Sample ADT A01 message containing alternate message delimiters
- [ADT_A03.hl7](ADT_A03.hl7): Sample ADT A03 message
